authority.ruling: Admit the AHX decoder data rows as D10c (removed codec). Complete NSO whole-text registry is ADX/HCA/RawPCM without AHX; Steam ordinary-section registry is ADX/HCA/Instrument/RawPCM without AHX. Hidden .arch callers are excluded under the standing .arch rule. Complete bounded default factories and actual registered interfaces satisfy the required finite-set proof.
authority.not_the_previous_failed_argument: Removing one branch from an ADX-family header decoder, a missing AHX name, no-reference, or byte similarity is insufficient. The positive evidence here is the concrete bounded Golden registrations and installed interface implementations.

scan_method.NSO: Every aligned32-bit word of complete mapped.text tested for A64 B/BL (mask0x7c000000==0x14000000), signed26-bit displacement scaled4; collect exacttarget3bad04 and3b2134. Each registration supplier is independently disassembled as a complete bounded body.
scan_method.Steam: Every E8/E9 byte position of complete ordinary.shared tested with signed32-bit displacement. Exacttarget sites are decoded within the complete corresponding wrapper/factory body; the over-approximate byte scan does not silently omit leaf functions absent from unwind metadata. .arch excluded.
scan_method.interface_identity: Getters return exact static13-slot tables; NSO table slots use their actual RELA addends. Slot0 GetInfo independently returns the exact codec version string. Constructor flow really passes this interface into the registrar and creates/publishes instances.
scan_method.format_boundary: This is the finite registered generic-decoder family, not a claim that Golden has only three/four audio formats. HCA-MX is a separate accelerated path; the admitted conclusion is removal of this old AHX decoder/data role, not removal of any real Golden codec.

required_seams: Golden mode must not retain these four PS2 AHX partitions, invoke their callback-state/table/bit-reader path, or install/register an AHX decoder as fallback. Use the actual Golden ADX/HCA/RawPCM and platform-specific Instrument interfaces and real native error/lifetime behavior. This does not remove the supported codecs or authorize fake decode success, silence, or dropped audio.

Route all direct/translated/native/inlined/computed consumers through the actual Golden codec driver. Original PS2 AHX behavior remains unchanged. Runtime GoldenM6b qualification is required; the NSO/private witness files are static evidence, never runtime dependencies.
